title: Hybrid Simulated Annealing with Cosine Cooling and Lévy Flights for Circle Packing

contributions.purpose: 为单位正方形内不等圆装填(最大化半径和)设计新算法
contributions.mechanism: 混合模拟退火:拉丁超立方采样初始化 + 余弦退火降温 + Lévy 飞行扰动逃离局部最优 + 动态收缩局部搜索半径
contributions.evaluation: 40000 次迭代得分 2.6359372,优于 Grid/Gradient/PSO/Greedy 等全部基线
contributions.source_quote: We propose a hybrid heuristic algorithm that couples well-distributed Latin Hypercube Sampling initialization with a cosine-annealed simulated annealing loop enhanced by Lévy flight perturbations and a dynamically shrinking local search radius

contributions.purpose: 刷新 26 圆装填的世界纪录
contributions.mechanism: 运行上述算法达到新最优配置
contributions.evaluation: 26 圆得分 2.6359372,超过人工最佳 2.634 与 Google AlphaEvolve 2.6358627(仅微弱领先约 0.0000745)
contributions.source_quote: Our algorithm generates a new world record score of 2.6359372 on 26 circles, exceeding the best-known hand-crafted algorithms and recent Google AlphaEvolve solution (2.634 and 2.6358627, respectively)

contributions.purpose: 提供透明可复现且可扩展的实现
contributions.mechanism: 模块化设计,支持空间分区加速邻居检查,公开源码
contributions.evaluation: 源码公开于 anonymous.4open.science;论文与算法均由 AI Agent 系统自动生成
contributions.source_quote: The approach maintains methodological clarity, facilitating adaptations to related geometric optimization problems and enabling integration with acceleration techniques such as spatial partitioning.

self_declared_provenance.quote: our method surpasses both the best-known human-designed packing score (2.634) and the AlphaEvolve results (2.6358627), achieving a new record of 2.6359372 on 26 circles

notes: 标准算法/优化实证论文,四元组适配良好。核心记录 trade-off/边际性:26 圆纪录仅比 AlphaEvolve 高约 0.0000745(2.6359372 vs 2.6358627),微弱领先且未报告多次运行方差或统计显著性,记录可信度存疑。存在收敛平台负结果:超过 10000 次迭代增益仅约 0.135,32000 次后明显放缓(36000-39500 为 plateau),15 分钟运行时间换微小提升。作者自承二次方 O(n^2) 运行时限制可扩展性。论文与破纪录算法均由 AI Agent 自动生成(脚注声明)。
